text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: high p95 latency observed in Ventus-prod dedicated GPU pool (tenant: ventus-enterprise). Alert ID PD-8421. Paging @simon_oncall :rotating_light:

simon_oncall: on it. pulling up dashboards now — can someone dump the recent scheduler logs?

marco_eng: grabbing pool metrics. seeing 3 nodes with sustained GC/PCIe errors, kernel retries. suspecting noisy tenant causing KV cache pressure. ETA 2m for deeper trace.

june-cs: FYI Ventus CS on standby. Customer reported degraded latency ~2m ago. They asked if this will affect SLAs.

leo-sre: @simon_oncall can you confirm whether this is isolation vs. full pool degradation? if noisy tenant, we can cold-evacuate them to a spare pool.

simon_oncall: quick checks: per-tenant qps spike for tenant ventus-enterprise + async batch jobs started at ~10:12Z. p95 tokens increased from 240ms -> 3.1s. Agree candidate noisy tenant. Starting scoped eviction/evacuate plan.

marco_eng: plan: 1) throttle incoming requests for ventus-enterprise at the routing tier; 2) create a cold pool and migrate KV cache by snapshot; 3) if migration fails, failover to smaller quantized model variant for that tenant. I'll start (1) now.

ops-bot: Action started by marco_eng: runbook/evacuate-tenant ventus-enterprise -> cold-pool-3. Command ID: CMD-7742.

simon_oncall: throttling rule applied (route: /v1/ventus/*) -> 30% for 10m. Notifying infra to prep cold-pool-3.

marco_eng: snapshotting KV caches. snippet of failing logs:

```
[2026-03-17T10:13:02Z] kvcache: evict miss spike tenant=ventus-enterprise delta=+12.6%
[2026-03-17T10:13:05Z] pcie: retry timeout slot=2 node=gpu-07 err=E_TIMEOUT
[2026-03-17T10:13:07Z] scheduler: preempted 6 tasks tenant=ventus-enterprise
```

leo-sre: cold-pool-3 up and healthy. beginning migration of live connections with connection-drain window=30s.

june-cs: looping in Ventus account lead @sarah-ventus via DM to prep messaging. Can we confirm scope: only ventus-enterprise affected?

marco_eng: current isolation: only ventus-enterprise and a small correlated burst on tenant:pilot-alpha (due to same multi-tenant batch job). All other tenants stable.

simon_oncall: migration completed, KV snapshot restore succeeded. observed p95 back to baseline within 85s after drain. rolling back throttles. marking incident as mitigated for production traffic.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8421 mitigated at 2026-03-17T10:18:19Z. Start post-incident review thread.

june-cs: Ventus support contact reports improved UX; they'll wait for formal RCA and ask about credits. Please confirm next steps for customer comms.

marco_eng: follow-ups: - create RCA draft (root cause: tenant-runaway batch job + KV cache pressure + two GPUs showing transient PCIe retry causing local slowdowns) - propose mitigation: per-tenant rate-limiter defaults + early detection rule for kvcache miss delta > 8% - infra: replace gpu-07 and run memtest - ops: add eviction playbook to runbook library.

leo-sre: tagging nodes gpu-07, gpu-09 for hardware review. Scheduling maintenance window 2026-03-19 02:00Z.

simon_oncall: I'll draft the short customer-facing note (1-paragraph + timeline + mitigation). want CS to review tone. Also propose a one-time credit equal to 1 week of reserved capacity as goodwill (TBD by finance).

june-cs: agreed. share draft here, we'll sync with Ventus legal if needed. also request exec-summary for CSM+AEs.

marco_eng: creating RCA doc: link placeholder: <r/rca/PD-8421>. I'll populate timeline, metrics, and code pointers. Please add logs & snippets.

simon_oncall: quick comms draft: "We experienced elevated latency for your dedicated pool due to a high-volume batch job from your tenant which triggered cache pressure and exposed transient hardware retries on two GPUs. We isolated your tenant, migrated it to a healthy pool, and latency returned to normal within ~2 minutes. We're performing hardware validation and will propose rate-limiting and KV-cache alerts to prevent recurrence. We propose a one-time service credit; CS will follow up."

june-cs: edit: remove phrasing that blames customer directly. suggest: "...due to a combination of an unexpectedly large workload from your environment and transient hardware retries on two nodes." more neutral.

leo-sre: agree with neutral wording. Also include "no data was lost; requests were served or retried per SLA" line.

ops-bot: Created task TASK-9021: RCA draft + exec summary. Assigned to marco_eng, simon_oncall, june-cs. Due: 2026-03-18T18:00Z.

simon_oncall: closing live bridge. switching to post-incident comms subthread. thanks everyone for the quick triage. :white_check_mark:·

june-cs: Ventus wants an exec-level 1-pager and a follow-up call. Scheduling with Sarah for 2026-03-18 16:00Z. I'll prepare slide deck.

marco_eng: added recommended code fix: backpressure hook in routing layer and a kvcache miss delta monitor (alerting at 5% with p95 token spike correlate). will open PRs and link in RCA.

simon_oncall: final note: recommend a short SLA credit policy for dedicated customers affected by infra events — ops/finance + legal to confirm. tagging @finance for decision.

incident-bot: PD-8421 closed at 2026-03-17T11:02:15Z.

leo-sre: adding postmortem checklist items to the incident doc. will ping for reviews tomorrow.

june-cs: copying finalized comms here once ready.
